title: Energy Sources
seo_title: Earth and Space Science 1: Energy Sources Worksheets (Strengthened SHS)
standard_code: Earth and Space Science 1, Quarter 2: Earth's Materials and Resources
standard_text: Energy sources: fossil fuels (coal, oil, natural gas) and how they form; geothermal, hydroelectric, solar, wind, tidal and biomass energy; nuclear energy; environmental impacts and sustainable energy use in the Philippines. (summary of the Strengthened Senior High School curriculum, Earth and Space Science 1, Quarter 2)
meta_desc: Free Earth and Space Science 1 worksheets (Strengthened SHS curriculum, Quarter 2): fossil fuels, geothermal and hydro power, solar and wind, nuclear energy and sustainability. 100 questions with answers.
key_big: Fossil fuels formed from ancient living things.
key_sub: The Philippines is a top producer of geothermal energy.
body_html:
How to think about it

Coal formed from ancient plants buried in swamps; oil and natural gas formed from marine organisms buried and heated over millions of years. They are non-renewable and release carbon dioxide when burned. The Malampaya field supplies natural gas to Luzon.

Renewable sources include geothermal (Tiwi, Makban, Leyte), hydroelectric dams, solar farms, wind farms (Bangui) and biomass. Each source has benefits and costs, such as land use, reliability and effects on wildlife. Energy efficiency reduces the need for new power stations.

Example

Which energy source uses heat from inside the Earth?

Volcanic areas

Answer: geothermal energy

Example

What did coal form from?

Swamp plants

Answer: ancient plants buried and compressed

Common mistakes

  • Thinking fossil fuels are renewable because plants still grow.
  • Thinking renewable energy has no impact.
  • Thinking nuclear plants burn fuel.

faq.q: Why is geothermal energy important to the Philippines?
faq.a: Many volcanic areas supply steam, giving reliable, low-carbon electricity.

faq.q: Why are solar and wind power variable?
faq.a: They depend on sunshine and wind, so storage or backup is needed.
